summary: monday.com Ltd. filed a 6-K with supplemental proxy disclosure for its 2026 Annual General Meeting on August 6, 2026. The supplement reports the cancellation of 10,875,000 unissued ordinary shares previously reserved under the 2021 Share Incentive Plan, following board and compensation committee approval. No share awards were affected. This routine equity reserve adjustment reflects ongoing dilution management and is not a special situation. The filing does not involve acquisitions, divestitures, activist campaigns, or any other event-driven category.
